note: Terms that identify an authorized-investment type in policy prose. Detection proposes; it never concludes. Blanket-incorporation phrasing is not duplicated here - it is read from the anti-pattern library of TX-PFIA-2256.005-b-4-A-001 so the two cannot drift.

terms: obligations of the state of texas

CMO_IO_PO_INVERSE.note: Prohibited under Sec. 2256.009(b). The generic phrase 'collateralized mortgage obligation' is deliberately absent: Sec. 2256.009(a)(4) permits agency-issued CMOs, so the bare term cannot distinguish a lawful holding from a prohibited one. Only the specifically prohibited forms are detectable by name. The over-ten-year CMO limb is a maturity condition rather than a term, and is left to the anti-pattern library of IS-2256.009-b-001.

terms: cash management and fixed income fund

NEGOTIABLE_CD.note: Distinct from the Sec. 2256.010 depository certificate. The lexicon lists the negotiable form explicitly so a policy naming both does not collapse into one code.

IHE_CORPORATE_BOND.note: The bare phrase 'corporate bond' maps to ISD_CORPORATE_BOND; only an institution of higher education can hold the Sec. 2256.020(3) form, and entity-class gating on the control settles which applies.

section_directive_note: Headings vary between policies more than any other element of a Texas IPS. Both singular and plural forms are listed because literal matching does not stem, and a heading that reads 'Authorized Investment Instruments' will not match 'authorized investments'. When a real policy produces state=section_not_located, read directive_trace in the detection report: it names every directive tried and where it hit, and adding the heading actually used is a one-line change here.
scope_phrases: for funds held for debt service
for the investment of bond proceeds
polarity_note: Polarity is decided per sentence, then inherited from an enumerated list's stem. The dominant Texas drafting pattern puts the authorization once - 'only the following investment types ... are authorized:' - and then lists the instruments as bare noun phrases with no cue of their own. Deciding polarity sentence by sentence reads that entire list as indeterminate and authorizes nothing.
incorporation_cues: as further defined by the pfia
as further defined by the public funds investment act
as further limited by the pfia
subject to the requirements of the pfia
as provided by the public funds investment act
as further defined by such trust agreement
incorporation_note: An incorporation clause attached to a closed list of types - 'only the following investment types, as further defined by the PFIA, are authorized' - is not blanket incorporation and must not be confused with it. Blanket incorporation leaves the set of types open, which is a Sec. 2256.005(b)(4)(A) failure. This clause closes the set of types and incorporates each type's statutory conditions by reference, which is a deliberate drafting device: the conditions then track amendments to the chapter without a policy rewrite. It is a complete answer for instrument conditions and no answer at all for the content Sec. 2256.005(b) requires the policy itself to decide.
